drafts.angle: Contrarian data claim, applied to marketing (rides @garrytan 'Jevon's Paradox broke for AI', 607K, new today)
drafts.draft_en:
Ramp data suggests cheaper AI isn't driving more usage right now.

My hunch on one bottleneck in marketing: generation got cheap. Approval didn't.

A team can make 100 ad variants in an hour.
Brand and legal still review them one at a time.

Cheaper tokens don't help when every output waits in a human queue.

Make review as fast as generation.
drafts.video_tip: 30s talking head, phone vertical. Open on a screenshot of Garry's post, then cut to a screen recording: 100 AI ad variants generated in seconds next to a review queue stuck at 3 approved. Burned-in captions, native upload, credit @garrytan in the first reply.

drafts.angle: Services scale without headcount, applied to agencies (rides @levie services-scale insight, 136K, bookmarks > likes)
drafts.draft_en:
Agencies were always capped by headcount.

Every new client meant more people making creative and more people checking it.

AI removed the cap on making.
It didn't remove the cap on checking.

The agencies that scale next will automate the check against brand rules, claims, and platform policy. Not just the output.
drafts.video_tip: 45s whiteboard or slide: two bars labeled 'make' and 'check'. Animate 'make' going 10x while 'check' stays flat, then show an automated check closing the gap with approve/fix/block labels. Voiceover reads lines 1 and 4. Captions on, link in the first reply.

drafts.angle: 10X output gap inside the same company (rides @levie '10X output gains… teams within the same company', 41K, new today + @gregisenberg 'software is dead' counter-proof, 89K)
drafts.draft_en:
Two marketing teams. Same company. Same AI tools.

One ships 10x more ads.

The gap is rarely the model.
It's the approval loop.

Team A waits days for brand and legal.
Team B checks every asset automatically and only escalates what fails.

Same models. Different loop.
drafts.video_tip: 35s split screen: left side 'Team A' calendar with a 3-day review wait, right side 'Team B' with each ad going through an automatic check in seconds and only one flagged. End on 'Same models. Different loop.' as a text card. Native vertical upload, no link in the post.
